title: 數位微鏡光學引擎~Digital-micromirror optical engines
focus: 以微鏡傾角、f 數、繞射級與光展量為核心的 DMD 照明、投影與圖樣投射引擎工程~DMD illumination, projection and pattern-projection engine design built on mirror tilt, f-number, diffraction orders and étendue
summary: 以 0.65 吋 1080p、7.56 µm 間距、±12° 傾角的數位微鏡元件為核心，推導照明 f 數與傾角的關係、微鏡陣列的繞射級位置與光展量上限，說明積分柱、TIR 稜鏡與投影鏡頭的設計規則，再以亮度鏈、對比、均勻度與圖樣時序的量測完成光學引擎的誤差預算與交接。~Built around a 0.65-inch 1080p digital micromirror device with 7.56 µm pitch and ±12° tilt, the course derives the illumination f-number from tilt angle, the diffraction-order positions and étendue ceiling of the mirror array, states the design rules of integrator rods, TIR prisms and projection lenses, and closes the engine's error budget and handoff through measurements of the luminous-flux chain, contrast, uniformity and pattern timing.

units.anchor: ±12° 微鏡傾角與照明入射角~±12° mirror tilt and illumination incidence
units.title: 微鏡傾角與照明 f 數~Mirror tilt and illumination f-number
units.mechanism: 數位微鏡元件的每個鋁鏡面繞對角線軸在 +12° 與 −12° 兩個穩態之間切換。照明光以傾角兩倍（24°）的角度射入，開態鏡面把光反射到元件法線方向進入投影鏡頭，關態鏡面則把光反射到法線另一側 48° 處被光吸收器接走，未上電的平態鏡面反射到 24°。要讓三個反射錐彼此不重疊，照明與投影的錐半角都不能超過傾角，這直接決定了引擎的最小 f 數，也決定亮度上限。~Each aluminium mirror of a digital micromirror device switches about a diagonal axis between two stable states at +12° and −12°. Illumination arrives at twice the tilt (24°); on-state mirrors send light along the device normal into the projection lens, off-state mirrors send it to 48° on the other side of the normal into a light absorber, and unpowered flat-state mirrors reflect at 24°. For the three reflected cones not to overlap, the half-angles of the illumination and projection cones must not exceed the tilt angle, which fixes the engine's minimum f-number and hence its brightness ceiling.
units.model: 最小 f 數 f/# = 1/(2·sinθ_tilt)：θ_tilt = 12° 時 f/# = 1/(2×0.2079) ≈ 2.4；θ_tilt = 17° 的元件可到 f/1.7，錐立體角大 (sin17°/sin12°)² ≈ 1.98 倍，同樣光源可多收近一倍的光。開態、平態與關態反射方向分別為 0°、24°、48°。~The minimum f-number is f/# = 1/(2·sinθ_tilt): for θ_tilt = 12°, f/# = 1/(2×0.2079) ≈ 2.4; a 17° device allows f/1.7 with a cone solid angle larger by (sin17°/sin12°)² ≈ 1.98, nearly doubling the light collected from the same source. On, flat and off reflections leave at 0°, 24° and 48° respectively.
units.verify: 把全白圖樣載入元件，用旋轉臂上的光度探頭在法線附近 ±30° 掃描反射光分佈，應看到中心開態主瓣、24° 的平態殘留與 48° 的關態瓣；主瓣半寬與照明 f 數換算的錐角一致，則幾何正確。~Load an all-white pattern and scan the reflected-light distribution within ±30° of the normal with a photometric probe on a rotating arm; the central on-state lobe, a flat-state remnant at 24° and the off-state lobe at 48° should appear, and a main-lobe half-width matching the cone angle implied by the illumination f-number confirms the geometry.
units.failure: 為了提高亮度把照明錐放大到 f/1.8（半角 16°），開態錐與平態錐在 12° 到 16° 之間重疊，黑畫面漏光使對比從 2000:1 掉到 300:1，亮度卻只多了約 70%。~Enlarging the illumination cone to f/1.8 (16° half-angle) for brightness lets the on-state and flat-state cones overlap between 12° and 16°; black-level leakage cuts contrast from 2000:1 to 300:1 while brightness gains only about 70%.
units.misconception: 微鏡只是一面小鏡子，照明角度可以任意選。~A micromirror is just a tiny mirror, so the illumination angle can be anything.

units.anchor: 7.56 µm 鏡面格點的繞射級~Diffraction orders of the 7.56 µm mirror lattice
units.title: 鏡陣繞射與光展量上限~Array diffraction and the étendue ceiling
units.mechanism: 微鏡陣列本身是一個二維閃耀光柵：週期 7.56 µm 的鏡面格點讓反射光只能存在於離散的繞射級，而傾斜的鏡面像閃耀面一樣決定能量落在哪幾個級。寬頻 LED 照明時各波長的級互相填補，投影錐內看起來連續；用雷射照明時各級變成分立亮點，對比與均勻性都受影響。光展量 G = A·π·sin²θ 由鏡面面積與可接受的錐角決定，光源的光展量一旦超過它，多出的光無論如何都進不了引擎。~The mirror array is itself a two-dimensional blazed grating: the 7.56 µm lattice allows reflected light only in discrete diffraction orders, while the tilted facets act as the blaze that decides which orders carry the energy. Under broadband LED illumination the orders of different wavelengths fill each other in and the projection cone looks continuous; under laser illumination the orders become separate bright spots that affect contrast and uniformity. The étendue G = A·π·sin²θ is fixed by mirror area and acceptance cone, and any source étendue beyond it cannot enter the engine by any means.
units.model: 級間角距 λ/p = 0.532/7.56 = 0.0704 rad ≈ 4.03°；入射 24° 時第 m 級方向 sinθ_m = m·0.0704 − 0.4067，m = 6 給 0.89°、m = 5 給 −3.1°，皆在 f/2.4 的 ±12° 錐內。0.65 吋元件有效面積 14.5×8.16 ≈ 118 mm²，G = 118×π×sin²12° ≈ 16.0 mm²·sr；2×2 mm 朗伯 LED 的 G = 4×π ≈ 12.6 mm²·sr，可完整利用。~The order spacing is λ/p = 0.532/7.56 = 0.0704 rad ≈ 4.03°; at 24° incidence the m-th order lies at sinθ_m = m·0.0704 − 0.4067, giving 0.89° for m = 6 and −3.1° for m = 5, both inside the ±12° cone of f/2.4. The 0.65-inch device has an active area of 14.5×8.16 ≈ 118 mm², so G = 118×π×sin²12° ≈ 16.0 mm²·sr; a 2×2 mm Lambertian LED has G = 4×π ≈ 12.6 mm²·sr and can be used in full.
units.verify: 以 532 nm 雷射擴束照射全白圖樣，在 1 m 處的屏幕上量繞射亮點間距，應為 1 m × tan(4.03°) ≈ 70 mm；再把 LED 換成已知面積與角分佈的光源，量進入投影鏡頭的流明，與光展量比值預測的收集效率比較。~Illuminate an all-white pattern with an expanded 532 nm laser and measure the spacing of diffraction spots on a screen 1 m away, expected at 1 m × tan(4.03°) ≈ 70 mm; then swap in an LED of known area and angular distribution, measure the lumens entering the projection lens and compare with the collection efficiency predicted by the étendue ratio.
units.failure: 選用 4×4 mm 的高功率 LED 想提高亮度，光展量 50 mm²·sr 是引擎的三倍，多出的三分之二光在積分柱與 TIR 稜鏡處被截掉並轉為熱，亮度未增反而把稜鏡膠合層烤裂。~Choosing a 4×4 mm high-power LED for brightness brings 50 mm²·sr of étendue, three times the engine's; two thirds of the light is clipped at the integrator rod and TIR prism and becomes heat, brightness does not rise and the prism cement cracks.
units.misconception: 光源功率越大，投影亮度一定越高。~Higher source power always gives a brighter projection.

units.anchor: 鋁鏡面、扭轉鉸鏈與 CMOS SRAM 單元~Aluminium mirror, torsion hinge and CMOS SRAM cell
units.title: DMD 元件結構與切換動力學~DMD device structure and switching dynamics
units.mechanism: 每個像素由鋁鏡面、下方的軛與扭轉鉸鏈、定址電極以及 CMOS 記憶單元組成：記憶單元先寫入下一個狀態，重置脈衝釋放鏡面後靜電力把它拉到對應的著陸點，鉸鏈的扭轉在數微秒內完成並在著陸點以機械止擋與彈簧尖端定住。鏡面之間留有次微米間隙與中央通孔，決定填充因子；密封窗口鍍增透膜並承受全部光功率。鉸鏈的疲勞壽命以兆次切換計，而鏡面黏附是主要的可靠度風險。~Each pixel consists of an aluminium mirror, a yoke and torsion hinge beneath it, address electrodes and a CMOS memory cell: the memory cell is written with the next state first, a reset pulse releases the mirror and electrostatic force pulls it to the matching landing point, where the hinge twist completes in a few microseconds and spring tips hold it against a mechanical stop. Sub-micrometre gaps between mirrors and the central via set the fill factor; a sealed window with antireflection coating carries the full optical power. Hinge fatigue life is counted in trillions of cycles, and mirror stiction is the main reliability risk.
units.model: 填充因子 ≈ ((p − g)/p)²：p = 7.56 µm、間隙 g = 0.3 µm 時 ≈ 92%。1920×1080 二元圖樣率 11,574 Hz 對應每圖樣 86.4 µs，資料率 2.07 Mbit × 11,574/s ≈ 24 Gbit/s；8 位元灰階 1,446 Hz 的每幀 691 µs，最低位元時槽 691/255 ≈ 2.7 µs，與鏡面穩定時間同量級。~Fill factor ≈ ((p − g)/p)²: with p = 7.56 µm and gap g = 0.3 µm it is about 92%. A 1920×1080 binary pattern rate of 11,574 Hz means 86.4 µs per pattern and a data rate of 2.07 Mbit × 11,574/s ≈ 24 Gbit/s; 8-bit grey at 1,446 Hz gives 691 µs per frame and a least-significant-bit slot of 691/255 ≈ 2.7 µs, the same order as mirror settling time.
units.verify: 以高速光電二極體對準單一鏡面或小區塊，示波器記錄切換後反射光的暫態與振鈴，量得穩定時間並與控制器的消隱時間比較；長期則以老化架連續切換並定期以顯微鏡與全白／全黑影像檢查黏附與損壞像素數。~Aim a fast photodiode at a single mirror or small block and record the reflected-light transient and ringing after a switch on an oscilloscope, comparing the settling time with the controller's blanking time; for lifetime, cycle devices continuously on a burn-in rack and periodically count stuck or damaged pixels with a microscope and all-white/all-black images.
units.failure: 窗口內殘留水氣使鏡面在著陸點黏附，以全黑圖樣長時間停放後部分像素無法釋放，畫面出現固定亮點；重置脈衝加強也無法恢復，只能更換元件。~Residual moisture inside the window makes mirrors stick at the landing point; after a long hold on an all-black pattern some pixels fail to release and appear as fixed bright dots, stronger reset pulses do not recover them and the device must be replaced.
units.misconception: 微鏡是類比連續偏轉的，可以停在任意角度。~Micromirrors deflect continuously and can be held at any angle.

units.anchor: 積分柱、中繼鏡組與 TIR 稜鏡~Integrator rod, relay optics and TIR prism
units.title: 照明光路：積分柱與 TIR 稜鏡~Illumination train: integrator rod and TIR prism
units.mechanism: 照明光路要把光源的空間與角度分佈轉成在 DMD 上均勻、錐角剛好 f/2.4、長寬比 16:9 的照明。積分柱靠多次全反射把輸入端的不均勻打散，出口面以中繼鏡組放大成像到 DMD；光展量守恆使放大倍率同時縮小角度，所以柱內光錐遠比 DMD 上陡。TIR 稜鏡把 24° 入射的照明光以全反射折向 DMD，而法線方向的開態光穿過同一個空氣間隙進入投影鏡頭，讓照明與投影在極短的後焦距內共用空間。~The illumination train must turn the source's spatial and angular distribution into uniform illumination on the DMD with exactly an f/2.4 cone and a 16:9 shape. The integrator rod scrambles the input non-uniformity by multiple total internal reflections, and relay optics image its exit face onto the DMD with magnification; étendue conservation makes that magnification shrink the angles, so the cone inside the rod is far steeper than at the DMD. The TIR prism folds the 24° illumination onto the DMD by total internal reflection while the on-state light along the normal passes through the same air gap into the projection lens, letting illumination and projection share space within a very short back focal distance.
units.model: 柱出口 3.6×2.0 mm 放大 M = 14.5/3.6 ≈ 4.0 倍到 DMD；光展量守恆 sinθ_rod = M·sinθ_DMD = 4×0.2079 = 0.83（空氣中 56°），玻璃內 sin = 0.83/1.5 = 0.554（33.7°，tan ≈ 0.667）；20 mm 長的柱每軸反射次數 ≈ 20×0.667/3.6 ≈ 3.7 次，達到 ≥3 次的均勻性經驗值。~A rod exit of 3.6×2.0 mm is magnified M = 14.5/3.6 ≈ 4.0 onto the DMD; étendue conservation gives sinθ_rod = M·sinθ_DMD = 4×0.2079 = 0.83 (56° in air), inside the glass sin = 0.83/1.5 = 0.554 (33.7°, tan ≈ 0.667); a 20 mm rod then makes ≈ 20×0.667/3.6 ≈ 3.7 reflections per axis, meeting the rule of thumb of at least 3.
units.verify: 在 DMD 位置放一片漫射屏，用相機從投影側量照度分佈，計算 9 點均勻度與邊緣衰減；再用光束分析儀在 DMD 面量角分佈，確認錐半角 12° 且中心指向 24°；若均勻度不足，延長積分柱或增加反射次數後重量。~Put a diffuser at the DMD position and image the illuminance distribution from the projection side with a camera to compute 9-point uniformity and edge roll-off; then measure the angular distribution at the DMD plane with a beam profiler to confirm a 12° half-angle centred on 24°; if uniformity is short, lengthen the rod or raise the number of reflections and re-measure.
units.failure: TIR 稜鏡的空氣間隙被膠或灰塵部分填滿，局部不再滿足全反射，照明在 DMD 上出現暗帶，而且部分照明光直接穿入投影鏡頭形成亮霧，對比與均勻度同時劣化。~If the TIR prism's air gap is partly filled by cement or dust, total internal reflection fails locally, a dark band appears on the DMD and some illumination passes straight into the projection lens as haze, degrading contrast and uniformity together.
units.misconception: 積分柱越長均勻度越好，所以長度沒有代價。~A longer integrator rod always improves uniformity, so length has no cost.

units.anchor: 積分球、9 點照度計與高速光電二極體~Integrating sphere, 9-point lux meter and fast photodiode
units.title: 亮度鏈、對比與時序量測~Flux chain, contrast and timing measurement
units.mechanism: 引擎驗收以三組量測為主：以 9 點照度乘以投影面積得到流明並與光源流明乘上各級效率的亮度鏈比較；以全白／全黑影像量順序對比、以 4×4 棋盤量 ANSI 對比，後者更能反映鏡頭的眩光；以高速光電二極體記錄單一像素在二元與灰階圖樣下的時間波形，檢查圖樣率、位元時槽與消隱。亮度鏈的每一項都要獨立量過，才能知道損失集中在哪一級。~Engine acceptance rests on three measurement groups: luminous flux from 9-point illuminance times projected area, compared with the flux chain of source lumens multiplied by each stage efficiency; sequential contrast from all-white/all-black images and ANSI contrast from a 4×4 checkerboard, the latter exposing lens veiling glare; and the time waveform of a single pixel under binary and grey-scale patterns recorded with a fast photodiode to check pattern rate, bit slots and blanking. Every stage of the flux chain must be measured on its own to locate where the loss concentrates.
units.model: 亮度鏈：LED 1500 lm × 收集 0.70 × 積分柱 0.90 × 中繼 0.90 × TIR 稜鏡 0.95 × DMD（填充 0.92 × 反射 0.88 × 繞射 0.86）× 投影鏡頭 0.90 ≈ 506 lm。對比：關態與鏡面間隙散射 0.03% 加鏡頭眩光 0.02%，順序對比 ≈ 1/(0.0003 + 0.0002) = 2000:1。~Flux chain: LED 1500 lm × collection 0.70 × rod 0.90 × relay 0.90 × TIR prism 0.95 × DMD (fill 0.92 × reflectance 0.88 × diffraction 0.86) × projection lens 0.90 ≈ 506 lm. Contrast: 0.03% scatter from off-state mirrors and gaps plus 0.02% lens veiling glare gives a sequential contrast ≈ 1/(0.0003 + 0.0002) = 2000:1.
units.verify: 用積分球量 LED 裸光通量，再依序在積分柱出口、DMD 前、投影鏡頭後以同一照度計量流明，逐級填入亮度鏈表；對比用遮光暗室中校正過的照度計量全黑畫面，確保暗讀值高於儀器底噪 10 倍以上。~Measure the bare LED flux in an integrating sphere, then with the same lux meter measure lumens at the rod exit, before the DMD and after the projection lens, filling each stage of the flux-chain table; for contrast, measure the all-black frame in a darkened room with a calibrated meter and keep the dark reading at least 10 times above the instrument noise floor.
units.failure: 量亮度時把投影鏡頭光圈開到 f/2.0 以求高讀值，平態與關態漏光一併進入，流明虛高 15% 而對比腰斬，驗收數據互相矛盾。~Opening the projection lens to f/2.0 for a higher flux reading admits flat- and off-state leakage; lumens read 15% high while contrast halves, and the acceptance data contradict each other.
units.misconception: 流明是光源的屬性，與引擎的 f 數無關。~Lumens are a property of the light source, independent of the engine f-number.

units.anchor: DMD 陣列溫度與熱阻模型~DMD array temperature and thermal-resistance model
units.title: 熱負載、灰階時序與誤差預算~Thermal load, grey-scale timing and error budget
units.mechanism: 引擎的誤差預算把亮度、對比、均勻度與灰階準確度的損失各自歸到可量化的來源：DMD 吸收的光功率與驅動電功率決定陣列溫度，溫度過高會縮短鉸鏈壽命並改變切換時間；灰階由二進位時槽疊加而成，鏡面穩定時間與最低位元時槽同量級時，低灰階會非線性並出現輪廓；雷射照明的離散繞射級與相干散斑則讓均勻度隨波長與角度起伏。各項以均方根合成，再決定是否加散熱、降圖樣率或改用寬頻光源。~The engine error budget assigns losses in brightness, contrast, uniformity and grey-scale accuracy to quantifiable sources: optical power absorbed by the DMD plus drive electrical power sets the array temperature, and excess temperature shortens hinge life and alters switching time; grey levels are built from binary time slots, so when mirror settling is comparable to the least-significant-bit slot the low greys turn nonlinear and show contouring; under laser illumination the discrete diffraction orders and coherent speckle make uniformity vary with wavelength and angle. The items are root-sum-squared before deciding on more cooling, a lower pattern rate or a broadband source.
units.model: 入射光 10 W、吸收 8% 得 0.8 W，加驅動電功率 1.5 W 共 2.3 W；晶片到底座熱阻 1.2 K/W、底座到環境 8 K/W（風冷）時陣列溫升 ≈ 2.3×9.2 ≈ 21 K，環境 35 °C 下陣列 56 °C，低於 70 °C 的典型上限。灰階：8 位元最低時槽 2.7 µs，鏡面穩定 5 µs，必須由控制器補償。~Incident 10 W with 8% absorption gives 0.8 W, plus 1.5 W drive power, 2.3 W in total; with 1.2 K/W die-to-base and 8 K/W base-to-ambient (forced air) the array rises ≈ 2.3×9.2 ≈ 21 K, reaching 56 °C at 35 °C ambient, below the typical 70 °C limit. Grey scale: the 8-bit least-significant slot of 2.7 µs against 5 µs mirror settling must be compensated by the controller.
units.verify: 以元件內建溫度感測或貼附熱電偶記錄陣列溫度對入射功率的斜率，與熱阻模型比較；用光電二極體量 0 到 255 灰階的時間平均光強，畫出電光轉換曲線並以最小平方擬合伽瑪，殘差超過 1 個灰階即需調整時槽補償表。~Log array temperature against incident power with the device's temperature sensor or an attached thermocouple and compare the slope with the thermal-resistance model; measure the time-averaged intensity for grey levels 0 to 255 with a photodiode, fit the electro-optical curve to a gamma by least squares, and adjust the slot-compensation table if residuals exceed one grey level.
units.failure: 為 3D 列印把 405 nm 光源加到 20 W 卻未改散熱，陣列溫度超過 70 °C，鏡面切換時間延長，固化圖樣邊緣變軟且數千小時後出現大量黏附像素。~Raising a 405 nm source to 20 W for 3D printing without changing the cooling pushes the array past 70 °C; switching slows, cured pattern edges soften and after a few thousand hours many pixels stick.
units.misconception: 鏡面是反射的，所以 DMD 不會吸收光功率、不需要散熱。~Mirrors reflect, so a DMD absorbs no optical power and needs no cooling.

units.anchor: 投影鏡頭倍率與成像面像素~Projection magnification and image-plane pixel
units.title: 圖樣投射系統整合：解析度與景深~Pattern-projection integration: resolution and depth of field
units.mechanism: 把引擎整合進 3D 列印、無光罩微影或結構光量測時，投影鏡頭的倍率決定像面的像素尺寸，而像方數值孔徑等於物方數值孔徑除以倍率，繞射光斑與景深都由它決定。DMD 側的 f/2.4 對應物方 NA 0.208；倍率越大像面像素越大、NA 越小、景深越深，解析度則由像素與繞射光斑中較大者決定。設計時要讓繞射光斑小於像素，又讓景深涵蓋平台的平面度與樹脂液面的起伏。~When the engine is integrated into 3D printing, maskless lithography or structured-light measurement, the projection magnification sets the pixel size at the image plane, and the image-side numerical aperture equals the object-side value divided by magnification, which in turn fixes the diffraction spot and depth of field. The f/2.4 at the DMD corresponds to an object-side NA of 0.208; larger magnification gives larger image pixels, smaller NA and deeper focus, with resolution set by the larger of pixel and diffraction spot. The design must keep the spot smaller than the pixel while the depth of field covers the platform flatness and resin-surface variation.
units.model: 目標像素 50 µm：M = 50/7.56 ≈ 6.6，像方 NA = 0.208/6.6 ≈ 0.0315；405 nm 的繞射光斑 1.22λ/NA = 1.22×0.405/0.0315 ≈ 15.7 µm，小於像素；景深 ±λ/(2NA²) = ±0.405/(2×0.00099) ≈ ±204 µm，可涵蓋 ±0.1 mm 的平台平面度；成像面尺寸 14.5×6.6 ≈ 96 mm 寬。~For a 50 µm target pixel, M = 50/7.56 ≈ 6.6 and image-side NA = 0.208/6.6 ≈ 0.0315; the 405 nm diffraction spot 1.22λ/NA = 1.22×0.405/0.0315 ≈ 15.7 µm is smaller than the pixel; the depth of field ±λ/(2NA²) = ±0.405/(2×0.00099) ≈ ±204 µm covers a ±0.1 mm platform flatness; the image field is 14.5×6.6 ≈ 96 mm wide.
units.verify: 投射單像素線對與 2、4、8 像素週期的光柵到像面，用顯微鏡相機量線寬與調制度得到 MTF；以 50 µm 步進移動像面量 MTF 對離焦曲線，確認 ±200 µm 內 2 像素週期的對比仍高於 50%。~Project single-pixel line pairs and gratings of 2, 4 and 8 pixel periods onto the image plane, measure line width and modulation with a microscope camera to obtain MTF; step the image plane in 50 µm increments to get MTF versus defocus and confirm that two-pixel-period contrast stays above 50% within ±200 µm.
units.failure: 為了放大列印面積把倍率拉到 20，像素 150 µm 看似可接受，但投影鏡頭的畸變在邊角達 0.3%，相當於 3 個像素的位置誤差，列印件在邊角尺寸超差卻在中央合格。~Raising magnification to 20 for a larger build area gives 150 µm pixels that look acceptable, but 0.3% lens distortion at the corners equals a three-pixel position error; printed parts are out of tolerance at the corners while passing at the centre.
units.misconception: 投影像素尺寸只由 DMD 像素間距決定。~The projected pixel size is set by the DMD pitch alone.

units.anchor: 均勻度地圖、固化深度與驗收報告~Uniformity map, cure depth and acceptance report
units.title: 均勻度驗收與工程交接~Uniformity acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 交接文件把引擎的光學規格與下游製程的敏感度連起來。對投影顯示，9 點均勻度與色彩不均勻以 ANSI 方法報告；對光固化列印，像面照度均勻度直接透過 Jacobs 固化深度關係 C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c) 轉成層厚誤差，因此均勻度規格必須從列印公差反推。報告需附亮度鏈表、對比、均勻度地圖、畸變圖、灰階曲線、熱與壽命數據，以及控制器韌體與時槽補償表的版本。~The handoff document ties the engine's optical specifications to the sensitivity of the downstream process. For projection displays, 9-point uniformity and colour non-uniformity are reported by the ANSI method; for photopolymer printing, image-plane irradiance uniformity converts directly into layer-thickness error through the Jacobs cure-depth relation C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c), so the uniformity specification must be derived backward from the print tolerance. The report carries the flux-chain table, contrast, uniformity map, distortion map, grey-scale curve, thermal and lifetime data, and the versions of controller firmware and slot-compensation tables.
units.model: 樹脂穿透深度 D_p = 100 µm、額定曝光量 E = 4E_c 時 C_d = 100×ln4 ≈ 139 µm；若照度高 10%，C_d = 100×ln4.4 ≈ 148 µm，多固化 9.5 µm；要把層厚誤差壓在 ±5 µm，像面照度均勻度須優於 ±5%。ANSI 9 點均勻度驗收門檻取 85%。~With resin penetration depth D_p = 100 µm and rated exposure E = 4E_c, C_d = 100×ln4 ≈ 139 µm; a 10% higher irradiance gives C_d = 100×ln4.4 ≈ 148 µm, 9.5 µm of over-cure; holding layer error to ±5 µm requires image-plane irradiance uniformity better than ±5%. The 9-point ANSI uniformity acceptance threshold is set at 85%.
units.verify: 用校正過的 405 nm 輻照度計在像面以 10 mm 網格量 100 點並繪均勻度地圖；列印一片測試層，以厚度計量各位置的固化厚度並與 Jacobs 關係預測比較；所有量測結果、韌體版本與補償表雜湊值一併寫入驗收報告。~Measure 100 points on a 10 mm grid at the image plane with a calibrated 405 nm irradiance meter and draw the uniformity map; print a test layer, measure cured thickness at each position with a thickness gauge and compare with the Jacobs prediction; write all results with firmware versions and compensation-table hashes into the acceptance report.
units.failure: 引擎以顯示規格「均勻度 80%」交付給列印機，邊角照度比中心低 20%，固化深度差 22 µm，列印件在邊角分層；因為交接文件沒有照度地圖，列印端花數週才找出是光學引擎而非樹脂問題。~An engine delivered to a printer under a display specification of 80% uniformity has corners 20% darker than the centre, a 22 µm cure-depth difference and delamination at the corners; with no irradiance map in the handoff, the printing team spends weeks before tracing the fault to the engine rather than the resin.
units.misconception: 顯示用的均勻度規格對任何應用都足夠。~A display-grade uniformity specification is enough for any application.

example: 設計練習：以 0.65 吋 1080p、7.56 µm、±12° 的 DMD 建一台 405 nm 光固化列印引擎。f/# = 1/(2·sin12°) ≈ 2.4，物方 NA = 0.208。有效面積 14.5×8.16 ≈ 118 mm²，光展量 G = 118×π×sin²12° ≈ 16.0 mm²·sr；2×2 mm 朗伯 LED 的 12.6 mm²·sr 可完整耦合。積分柱出口 3.6×2.0 mm，放大 4.0 倍，柱內玻璃中錐角 33.7°，20 mm 長每軸反射 ≈ 3.7 次。亮度鏈：1500 lm × 0.70 × 0.90 × 0.90 × 0.95 × 0.92 × 0.88 × 0.86 × 0.90 ≈ 506 lm。像面像素 50 µm 需 M = 6.6，像方 NA 0.0315，繞射光斑 15.7 µm，景深 ±204 µm，像面寬 96 mm。熱：吸收 0.8 W 加電功率 1.5 W，熱阻 9.2 K/W，溫升 21 K。固化深度 C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c)，D_p = 100 µm、E = 4E_c 得 139 µm，照度 +10% 多固化 9.5 µm，故均勻度規格取 ±5%。數值為教學假設。~Design exercise: build a 405 nm photopolymer printing engine on a 0.65-inch 1080p DMD with 7.56 µm pitch and ±12° tilt. f/# = 1/(2·sin12°) ≈ 2.4, object-side NA = 0.208. Active area 14.5×8.16 ≈ 118 mm² gives étendue G = 118×π×sin²12° ≈ 16.0 mm²·sr; a 2×2 mm Lambertian LED with 12.6 mm²·sr couples in full. The integrator rod exit is 3.6×2.0 mm, magnified 4.0 times, with a 33.7° cone inside the glass and ≈ 3.7 reflections per axis over 20 mm. Flux chain: 1500 lm × 0.70 × 0.90 × 0.90 × 0.95 × 0.92 × 0.88 × 0.86 × 0.90 ≈ 506 lm. A 50 µm image pixel needs M = 6.6, image-side NA 0.0315, a 15.7 µm diffraction spot, ±204 µm depth of field and a 96 mm wide field. Thermal: 0.8 W absorbed plus 1.5 W electrical through 9.2 K/W gives a 21 K rise. Cure depth C_d = D_p·ln(E/E_c) with D_p = 100 µm and E = 4E_c is 139 µm, and +10% irradiance over-cures by 9.5 µm, so the uniformity specification is set at ±5%. Values are teaching assumptions.
history: 1987 年德州儀器的 Larry Hornbeck 發明數位微鏡元件，1996 年 DLP 投影技術商品化，2000 年前後進入數位電影放映；微鏡傾角由早期的 ±10° 演進到 ±12° 與 ±17°，像素間距縮到 5 µm 級。2010 年代起高圖樣率控制器讓 DMD 成為結構光三維量測、光固化 3D 列印、無光罩微影與壓縮感測光譜儀的核心元件，台灣的揚明光學等廠商則專精於 DLP 光學引擎的量產；本課只整理公開的光學設計與量測方法。~Larry Hornbeck at Texas Instruments invented the digital micromirror device in 1987, DLP projection was commercialized in 1996 and entered digital cinema around 2000; mirror tilt evolved from the early ±10° to ±12° and ±17°, and pitches shrank toward the 5 µm class. From the 2010s high-pattern-rate controllers made the DMD the core of structured-light 3D measurement, photopolymer 3D printing, maskless lithography and compressive-sensing spectrometers, while Taiwanese makers such as Young Optics specialized in volume production of DLP optical engines; this course covers only public optical design and measurement methods.
